# Decision entry template

Copy the block below to the end of `docs/decisions.md`, add a row to the table at its top, and use the next free `D-NNN`. Keep it short: the decision, the reason, a pointer.

```markdown
## D-NNN

YYYY-MM-DD. **Decision in one sentence.** What changes for users or contributors, in one or two sentences. Why: the reason, with the measurement if there is one (reads gained or lost, false positives, latency). Supersedes D-NNN (if any). See [relevant doc](FILE.md#anchor).
```

Rules: one decision per entry; never edit an old entry's substance (add a new one that supersedes it and mark the old one `Superseded by D-NNN`); defaults and scope changes are recorded only after the owner decided.
